voice.summary: Linden Physiotherapy sounds like a calm clinician: clear about the time, the length and the person you will see. It uses short, kind sentences and never makes someone feel rushed.
dos: State the day, time, length and clinician in full
Explain the five-minute hold in plain words
donts: Do not use medical terms the patient has not used
Avoid pressure about slots running out

taglines: Moving better starts with a booking
Pick a day. We will hold it
boilerplate: Linden Physiotherapy is a clinic offering initial assessments and follow-up treatment with an online booking form that holds a chosen slot for five minutes.

microcopy.success: Booked. We will see you then.
microcopy.error: That slot was released. Please pick another.

logo.note: A pulse line signals movement and care without leaning on a medical cross.
